from machine import I2C, Pin, ADC
import time
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
a = ADC(Pin({VA}))
b = ADC(Pin({VB}))
def v(x):
    return x.read_u16() * 3.3 / 65535
# Multi-write: A from VDD (code 1241), B from the internal 2.048 V reference x1 (code 2000)
i2c.writeto(0x60, bytes([0x40, 0x00 | (1241 >> 8), 1241 & 0xFF, 0x42, 0x80 | (2000 >> 8), 2000 & 0xFF]))
time.sleep_ms(20)
print('A=%.2f B=%.2f' % (v(a), v(b)))
# Gain x2 on all channels: B doubles
i2c.writeto(0x60, bytes([0xCF]))
time.sleep_ms(20)
print('B2=%.2f' % v(b))
# Fast write A=0, B=0 (power-down A)
i2c.writeto(0x60, bytes([0x10, 0, 0, 0]))
time.sleep_ms(20)
print('A0=%.2f' % v(a))
